starting_point.kind: upstream repository at the task base commit
starting_point.note: The runner clones the repository and checks out the base commit. The scenario-2 start point is a repository, so it cannot be stored as files inside the Yudao repository; the base commit pins it exactly.

runtime.network: The environment build needs GitHub and PyPI; this happens before the run.
runtime.test_command: uv run --python 3.13 python -m pytest <ids from the hidden lists>

reference_solution.origin: upstream fix commit, the same change FeatBench records as its gold patch

hidden_checks.note: The hidden test files are stored as whole files. Scoring overwrites the delivery's copy, so a delivery that edits a test is scored against the material's version.

digests.note: LF 规范化、递归、跳过 __pycache__ 与 *.pyc
